scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:local: node scripts/patch-wrangler.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:remote: node scripts/patch-wrangler.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run config:production && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler.production.json
scripts.db:production: npm run config:production && node scripts/patch-wrangler.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .wrangler.production.json

DB.description: Stores upstream configuration and encrypted access keys. For a new deployment, choose **Create new** and a unique database name; do not reuse another instance's database.

ADMIN_KEY.description: Management login password: generate at least 32 random characters, for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep a backup.

UPSTREAM_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encryption key: use `openssl rand -base64 32` (exactly 32 random bytes). Back it up with D1 and keep it unchanged on redeploys.
